markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
One conformal class, both models agree, and 5/5 neighbors are invasive [F1][F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Clear separation |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.998 / 92nd percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class as classifier | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest association; scored above typical [F2] · Validated (19/20)
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 4, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical nuclear atypia · Validated (18/20)
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules lean invasive in concept model · Weak (18/20)
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low score leans invasive; marginal spot check · Weak (12/20)
- **Mitoses and necrosis** (regions 1, 4, 5; 10) · ↑ invasive · High scores, but failed spot checks · Unreliable (0/20, 3/20)

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) and 92nd-percentile OOD distort the embeddings.
- Reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 10, 11** — confirm invasive tumor in stroma, not reactive stroma.
2. **Region 10** — assess necrosis and intraductal cells; both scores unreliable.
3. **Superior and inferior margins** — verify suggested tumor-at-margin call [F7].
